adjacency.source: global canonical Natural Earth application-country topology

boundaryPolicy.russia: one canonical whole-country RUS geometry; excluded only from Europe viewport fit/focus so the SVG viewport can crop eastern geometry without shrinking Europe
boundaryPolicy.france: one canonical whole-country FRA geometry including French Guiana; excluded from Europe fit/focus so overseas geometry does not distort Europe
boundaryPolicy.norway: one canonical whole-country NOR geometry; remote multipart source geometry is excluded from Europe fit/focus
boundaryPolicy.microstates: AND/LIE/LUX/MCO/SMR/VAT use mainland callouts after phone-scale geometry audit; MLT uses the island locator; canonical polygon geometry is retained
boundaryPolicy.turkiyeCyprusCaucasus: TUR/CYP/ARM/AZE/GEO are keyed non-scoring context; canonical ownership remains outside Europe curriculum
boundaryPolicy.kosovo: non-scoring source context; no Atlas application-country target
boundaryPolicy.gibraltar: non-scoring British Overseas Territory context; no Atlas application-country target
boundaryPolicy.crownDependencies: Jersey, Guernsey and Isle of Man are non-scoring Crown Dependency context; no Atlas application-country targets
boundaryPolicy.aland: non-scoring autonomous Finnish territory context; no Atlas application-country target
boundaryPolicy.faroeIslands: non-scoring autonomous Danish territory context; no Atlas application-country target
boundaryPolicy.overseasAndDependencies: other source features remain non-scoring context unless reconciled to a canonical Atlas country
boundaryPolicy.crossContinentAdjacency: global application-country topology preserves complete RUS and other cross-continent land borders

runtimeOptimization.method: projection-space path quantization plus Ramer-Douglas-Peucker for non-interactive physical context
